description:
This image is a screenshot of the Copernicus Land Monitoring Service (CLMS) Core user interface, displaying the details for a data ingestion named 'UA_IBK_2018'. The interface is structured with a top navigation bar, a "General Information" section on the left, a map preview in the center, and an "Input Classes" table below the map.

The top navigation bar includes links for "Data Catalogue", "EAGLE Ontology", "About EAGLE", "Organisations", "Users", and "CLC+ Core User Admin/Support". The main page title is "Data Catalogue / Ingestion 'UA_IBK_2018'", with a status tag "INGESTED_PRE" (7).

The "General Information" section on the left provides metadata for the 'UA_IBK_2018' ingestion:
*   Name: UA_IBK_2018
*   Country: Austria/Österreich
*   Region: Innsbruck
*   Reference Year: 2018
*   Time Range of Ingested Data: 01.01.2018 - 31.12.2018
*   INSPIRE Themes: LU Land use, LC Land cover
*   Created By: CLC+ Core User Admin/Support
*   Organisation/s: CLC, European Environment Agency (EEA)
An "EDIT" button is available next to the "General Information" heading.

A map preview is displayed on the right, showing an aerial/satellite imagery base layer of the Innsbruck region, filtered for "AT Austria/Österreich" and "AT332 Innsbruck". A green overlay highlights a specific area within the region. The map includes zoom controls, layer toggles, and a scale bar showing "10 km" and "5 mi". A "PREVIEW" button (5) is located above the map.

Above the map, there are buttons for "REPUBLISH ON GEOSERVER", "START INGESTION", and "PUBLISH" (6). Below the map, a "DOWNLOAD EAGLE BARCODING" button (4) is visible.

The "Input Classes" table lists specific land cover classes relevant to the ingestion, with columns for:
*   "Class Code ↑": Numeric identifiers (e.g., 11100, 11210, 11220, 11230).
*   "Name *": Editable names corresponding to the class codes (e.g., "11100").
*   "EAGLE Elements *" (3): Describes the class mapping according to the EIONET Action Group on Land monitoring in Europe (EAGLE) concept, such as "Sealed Artificial Surfaces and Constructions +10" or "Sealed Artificial Surfaces and Constructions +11".
*   "100% EAGLE compliant" (2): Indicates compliance with EAGLE specifications (all classes shown have a green checkmark).
*   "Colour": Small coloured squares (red, dark red, medium red, light red) representing the visualization colour for each class.
*   "Show in Map": Toggle switches, all currently off, indicating these specific classes are not actively displayed on the map preview.

An "APPROVE EAGLE COMPLIANCE" button (1) is located below the 'UA_IBK_2018' title.
